reply: The 7-point score is 6, which is at or above the threshold of 3, and the criteria_implied_action is excision. The pattern model diagnosed MISC with 0.6927 confidence, but this conflicts with the checklist’s melanoma-suspicious score; the guideline corpus contains no recommendation for MISC, but for melanoma (MEL), it includes recommendations such as DOI:10.1016/j.jaad.2018.08.055 and DOI:10.1016/j.ejca.2024.115153, which support complete excision when melanoma is suspected.
